UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer Resigns Amid Political Pressure

United Kingdom Prime Minister Keir Starmer has announced his resignation, citing mounting political pressure and a loss of support from Labour MPs. His departure follows a bye-election setback and the victory of Andy Burnham in Westminster. The reasons for his resignation are being analyzed, with some outlets pointing to internal party conflicts and others to specific policy inaction.
